mentions.name: oamc
mentions.description: A local-first tool that turns research material into a maintained markdown wiki. Sources are ingested into a structured wiki of source pages, concept pages, entity pages, and synthesis pages; questions are then asked against the wiki, and useful answers are written back as new pages. Everything stays file-based and Obsidian-friendly, with a local dashboard and a macOS menubar app so it keeps running in the background.
mentions.problem: Repeatedly querying raw notes or documents isn't cumulative; chat lacks accumulation and a full RAG stack is too heavy to set up.
mentions.audience: Individuals doing personal research and maintaining project memory
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a local-first tool for turning research material into a maintained markdown wiki.

The idea is simple: instead of repeatedly querying raw notes or documents, sources get ingested into a structured wiki with source pages, concept pages, entity pages, and synthesis pages. Then questions are asked against that wiki, and useful answers get written back as new pages.
